action_items: MINOR: Fix React DOM nesting warnings in QuoteForm.js (~line 820) and InvoiceForm.js (~line 211) — invalid <span> wrapping <tr>/<tbody>/<th> elements in live preview. Causes console errors and React 19 hydration issues.

OPTIONAL: server.py is now 2055 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting routes (clients, quotes, invoices, relances, profiles, email) into separate routers/modules for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py 2055 lines — should be split into multiple routers (clients/quotes/invoices/email/relances).

Live PDF preview component generates invalid HTML (span > tr/tbody/th) — works visually but breaks hydration. Should use proper table semantics or refactor the preview into a separate component using raw HTML rendering.
evalExpression in CRM.jsx uses Function() constructor — input is regex-restricted to [\d+\-*/().,] so safe, but adding a clearer comment would help future maintainers.

Note auto-save: useEffect debounce uses 800ms; depends on client object reference. Re-renders on parent state changes could retrigger save. Consider using a ref to compare 'lastSavedNotes' to avoid unnecessary PATCH calls.
/api/quotes/{id}/public-token endpoint is idempotent (good). Consider also exposing similar endpoint for invoices for symmetry if invoices also need public links.
